logp.method_description: The lipophilicity (log Po/w) was measured according to the literature method. Equal amounts of n-octanol and phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) were thoroughly mixed in the oscillator for 24 hours. The mixture was then left to separate for a further 24 hours in order to obtain water and oil phase both which were saturated with the other. 1-3 were carefully dissolved in PBS (saturated with n-octanol) and obtained the saturated solution at room temperature (concentration denoted as Co). The saturated solution was then mixed with an equal amount of n-octanol (saturated with PBS) and shaken on oscillator for another 24 hours. After separation, the final concentration of1-3 in water phase as denoted as Cw. Both Co and Cw were measured by emission spectra area between 380-700 nm at the excitation light lex=350 nm. The lipophilicity of 1-3 was calculated according to the equation: log Po/w= log [(Co- Cw)/Cw].
